sourceEvidence.quote:
Type I: TAP mutation → ↓ MHC I → ↓ CD8+ T cells → chronic respiratory infections, skin
granulomas, vasculitis; normal Ig.
sourceEvidence.verifiedHow: pdftotext text-layer containment on pinned pages (verify-evidence.ts)

sourceEvidence.quote:
Type II: transcription factor mutations → ↓ MHC II → ↓ CD4+ T cells + antigen-presenting
cell/B-cell dysfunction → SCID-like infections; ↓ Ig.
sourceEvidence.verifiedHow: pdftotext text-layer containment on pinned pages (verify-evidence.ts)

sourceEvidence.quote: Treatment: allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplant, IVIG.

kypExtensions.summary: Reading MHC I and II as one display scaffold in two settings: groove filled inside (RER via TAP) for the cytosol's story to CD8 on every nucleated cell, versus groove filled outside-in (lysosome after invariant-chain release) for the ingested story to CD4 on APCs only.
kypExtensions.rationale: The source presents the two classes as parallel table columns; unifying them as one scaffold with two loading routes and two audiences is KYP's integrative model.
kypExtensions.location: core.keyIdea + both mechanism captions + visual caption
